basis: production-stack backtest, 797 seeded active players, real historical outcomes
method: thresholds on P(change); fitted on half the players, figures below are HELD-OUT

competitive.note: UNCHANGED. Tertiles gave 93.3/92.4/82.3 - no separation - because competitive accuracy is uniformly high. Only the claimed accuracies moved.

duel.note: RECALIBRATED. The old 0.15/0.45 put 91.2% of reads in 'high' at 70.8% pooled / 61.2% macro - the label was lying. High is now rare and honest.
wired code on held-out players; every band beat its claim, i.e. the published figures are conservative

subpopulation_caveat: Competitive accuracy depends on WHO the player is. Held-out competitive high-band accuracy is 91.3% for competitive-only players but 82.9% for duel-capable players scored on their competitive history. The published 0.905 describes the competitive population; it overstates the band for players who mainly play duels.
